command:
import pathlib,tempfile
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import reference_retention as r
import evidence_bundle as b
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    root=pathlib.Path(folder)
    (root/'.local').mkdir()
    (root/'.local/data').write_bytes(b'bounded synthetic evidence')
    entries=b.inventory(root,['.local'])
    manifest={'selected_paths':['.local'],'members':[{'path':name,'directory':name.endswith('/'),'original_bytes':size,'original_sha256':b.file_sha(root/name) if not name.endswith('/') else b.sha(b'')} for name,_,size in entries]}
    print('Actual codec member names:',[x['path'] for x in manifest['members']])
    print('Matching live directory count:',r.verify_live_members(root,manifest))
